build_system: Bundler (Ruby gems) + Yarn/Corepack (JS packages), Rails asset pipeline with Propshaft
test_framework: RSpec for Ruby (spec/ directory), Jest for JavaScript
build_command: ruby -c (for Ruby files) && npx tsc --noEmit (for TypeScript)
test_command: bundle exec rspec spec/path/to_spec.rb (specific specs); npx jest (JS tests)
verification_instructions: 1. Run ruby -c on all new/modified .rb files. 2. Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compiles. 3. Run node --check streaming/index.js to verify streaming server syntax.
snapshot_or_generated_files: db/schema.rb is regenerated by rails db:migrate. No other snapshots.
setup_instructions: 1. bundle install 2. yarn install 3. bin/rails db:setup (requires postgres)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Ruby 3.4.4, Node.js v22 available. PostgreSQL NOT running in sandbox - validate code structurally. No test DB available for RSpec execution.
contribution_requirements: DO NOT modify existing DB tables (conversations, account_conversations, conversation_mutes). DO NOT modify existing API responses. New tables and APIs only. All new API under /api/v1/dm/ namespace. OAuth scopes: read:dm, write:dm.

key_patterns.controllers: Inherit from Api::BaseController. Use doorkeeper_authorize! for auth. Use require_user! before_action. Pagination via insert_pagination_headers.
key_patterns.serializers: Use ActiveModelSerializers. Class inherits from ActiveModel::Serializer. IDs returned as strings via .to_s.
key_patterns.services: Inherit from BaseService. Main method is #call.
key_patterns.workers: Include Sidekiq::Worker and Redisable. Use perform_async for enqueueing.
key_patterns.models: Inherit from ApplicationRecord. Use enum, scope, belongs_to/has_many.
key_patterns.streaming: Redis pub/sub. Workers publish JSON with event/payload to redis timelines.
key_patterns.frontend_reducers: TypeScript with plain objects. Actions have type constants.
key_patterns.frontend_routing: WrappedRoute in features/ui/index.jsx maps paths to lazy-loaded components.
key_patterns.sounds: soundsMiddleware in store/middlewares/sounds.ts listens for actions with meta.sound property. Sound 'boop' already cached. Add new sounds to soundCache in ready().
key_patterns.search_api: apiGetSearch in api/search.ts uses v2/search endpoint with type parameter (accounts, statuses, hashtags).

directory_structure: Standard Rails: app/{models,controllers,services,serializers,workers,lib}/, config/routes/, db/migrate/, spec/ for tests. Frontend: app/javascript/mastodon/{features,reducers,actions,api,components}/. Streaming: streaming/index.js (Node.js). Styles: app/javascript/styles/mastodon/.
